notes.title: [PLACEHOLDER] Pushes and nudges
notes.science: [PLACEHOLDER] A small push at the right moment can change where someone ends up.
notes.limits: [PLACEHOLDER] The wind here moves bodies and sometimes a dial.
notes.counter: [PLACEHOLDER] Some say people go where they were going anyway.
notes.question: [PLACEHOLDER] Was it the wind or Wisp?

notes.title: [PLACEHOLDER] Leaving
notes.science: [PLACEHOLDER] People leave groups for many reasons, and some never say why.
notes.limits: [PLACEHOLDER] Here leaving over the ridge is for good.
notes.counter: [PLACEHOLDER] Some leavings are a beginning, not an end.
notes.question: [PLACEHOLDER] Would Wisp have gone without the wind?
